info.name: 2. Asset Service - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Asset Management Service. Swagger: asset-service/docs/swagger/asset_openapi.yaml. Base URL: localhost:8085

**Structure (23 folders):**
1. Asset Scanning | 2. Assets | 3-9. Master Data (Categories, SubCategories, Makes, Models, Vendors, Outlets, Components) | 10. User Links | 11. Documents | 12. Warranty | 13. AMC | 14. Compliance | 15. Compliance Rules | 16. Master Data Agent | 17. Audit Agent | 18. User Asset Link Agent | 19. LLM & Extraction | 20. File Download | 21. Statuses | 22. Entity Types | 23. Document Types

**Component-Asset Linking:** Use optional assetId in Create/Update Component to link component to asset.
